text:
Maya L: heads up — running `make gen` in sample-app produced a tiny typegen diff that blocked the publishflow CI for the sdk bundle. not sure if it's a semver issue or just ordering noise

Jon P: ugh, I saw that too. regen-check job failed on one runner, passed on another. looks like property ordering in the OpenAPI -> typegen path is nondeterministic

Samira K: is it the enum ordering again? those diffs usually read like: 
```diff
- export type Foo = \"bar\" | \"baz\";
+ export type Foo = \"baz\" | \"bar\";
```
Which should be safe and not deserve a minor bump but changelog-gen flagged it as a codegen change

CI Bot: regen-check — job failed on runner: ubuntu-20.04-1, exit code 1, diff detected in packages/sample-app/src/types/generated.ts

Jon P: changelog automation currently looks at the presence of any typegen diffs -> suggests a minor. that's what prevented the npm publish guard from completing. we need to either suppress ordering-only diffs or make typegen stable

Alex R: quick mitigation: add a stable-sort pass in the typegen post-process and require it in CI. patch can be small. will that be acceptable for semver rules?

Samira K: yes acceptable — we consider ordering-only changes to be non-semver (patch). but the changelog bot is dumb about that. we either update changelog rules or teach the regen linter to ignore pure-order diffs

Maya L: I can whip up a PR that adds a stable sort + test to assert deterministic output. also add a regen-ignore rule for enum-order-only changes in the changelog script. which do we prefer? both?

Jon P: both. short-term: add regen-ignore so publish unblocks. long-term: stable-sort in typegen runtime.

Samira K: FYI the flaky runner is masking root cause — we should reproduce locally by running `OPENAPI_DEBUG=1 make gen` on linux docker image to be sure it's not locale/JSON stringify order dependant

Alex R: noted. repro steps:
1) checkout sample-app@main
2) docker run -v $PWD:/src node:18-bullseye sh -c "cd /src && npm ci && make gen"
3) git status to see diffs

Jon P: I pushed a tiny draft: https://github.com/redwood/sample-app/pull/1234 that applies stable-sort and updates regen-check job to run the docker repro. CI currently failing on one lint rule but regen diff gone locally for me

Maya L: awesome. I'll add a changelog exclusion for typegen-order-only and a one-time note in the release checklist so oncall knows the reason if it shows up again :wave:

CI Bot: publishflow guard: blocked — regen-check failed -> awaiting manual override

Samira K: manual override ok for this release if PR merged before EOD. but we should not make manual overrides habitual

Alex R: agree. action items:
- Maya: PR to add changelog ignore rule (PR #1235)
- Jon: finish stable-sort PR and CI docker step (PR #1234)
- Samira: add a small test asserting stable output across node versions

Maya L: plan sounds good. I'll ping in #release-war-room once both PRs are merged and CI is green so someone can flip the guard

Jon P: thanks all. follow-up: we should add a devex doc snippet explaining what counts as semver for autogenerated types — less surprises for SDK authors

Samira K: adding to my todo list. closing loop after we merge. :thumbsup:
